svg.title: Europe Healthtech Cloud Trust and FinOps Owner Dashboard Demo
svg.desc: Demo-only owner dashboard for European healthtech AI and cloud evidence rooms. It shows synthetic cost-owner, evidence-owner, adviser-question and human-review queues with no real patient data, savings, compliance or certification claim.

g.text: Europe Healthtech Cloud Trust + FinOps Owner Dashboard
DEMO / SYNTHETIC ONLY — no patient data, real client, savings, GDPR/EU AI Act proof, certification or clinical claim
1. Map cloud and AI spend to cost owner, evidence owner and decision next step before optimization claims.
2. Keep GDPR, DPIA, EU AI Act, security, legal, privacy, clinical and billing questions in adviser status.
3. Separate human-review boundaries from automation scope for patient, payer, complaint and regulated wording.
4. Block security-questionnaire or trust-centre answers until source, owner, limitation and review date exist.
5. Give CFO, CTO, DPO/CISO and RevOps one buyer-safe evidence room around existing FinOps and GRC tools.

svg.text: AICloudStrategist demo artifact generated 2026-08-26 for Europe / UK-EU healthtech buyer visibility.
